in_marathi.name: Samarvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Alliances, Kinship, Lineage
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samarvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rooted in Sanskrit, Samarvansh is a name that signifies alliances and kinship. It refers to the lineage and connection of an individual to their ancestors and the community. In Hindu mythology, it is also associated with the concept of Rishi Samarvansh, where all the great sages come together to impart knowledge and wisdom.
